name: Bonds, BG, Insurances, Stamp Duty, CIDB, bank charge, office rental, invoice finance interest, etc.
description: Printed Malaysian stamp-duty law and rates for bonds/guarantees, insurance, leases and factoring/invoice-finance instruments, plus CIDB registration framework. No bank guarantee commission, insurance premium or invoice-finance interest rate was found.
aliases: Bonds, BG, Insurances, Stamp Duty, CIDB, bank charge, office rental, invoice finance interest, etc.

specifications.metric: Stamp duty on bonds, performance guara — ad valorem duty, first RM100,000 of value
specifications.unit: RM per RM100 or part thereof
specifications.basis: HASiL Guideline LHDN.AG.600-1/10/3 printed 30 June 2026, sections C/E item 32(a): first RM100,000 RM1.00; >RM100,000 to RM500,000 RM2.00; >RM500,000 to RM1,000,000 RM3.00; >RM1,000,000 RM4.00, on consideration or market value whichever higher; Section F lists bonds, security instruments, guarantees, facility and factoring agreements as chargeable on consideration/loan amount.

specifications.metric: Stamp duty on bonds, performance guara — fixed duty for general stamping (insurance policies, guarantees, construction agreements)
specifications.basis: Same HASiL guideline printed 30 June 2026, section G: instruments outside the specific categories are stamped generally at RM10; printed examples include Polisi Insurans / Cargo Insurance Policy, Performance Bond, Performance Guarantee, Insurance Guarantee, Takaful Guarantee, Letter of Guarantee and Indemnity, and Factoring Agreement (section F 4.22 / 4.14 / G 4.11).

specifications.metric: Stamp duty on bonds, performance guara — fixed duty for office/tenancy instruments not otherwise chargeable
specifications.basis: Same guideline printed 30 June 2026, section A 2.2 items 49(d)-49(f): RM10.00 fixed for share-of-produce leases, duplicate lease instruments and other lease instruments; section G general fixed duty RM10.

specifications.metric: CIDB contractor registration (Act 520) — year Act 520 was enacted
specifications.basis: CIDB Malaysia web page read 25 Nov 2026: 'Akta 520 adalah satu tindakan untuk membentuk Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia (CIDB) pada tahun 1994'; scope includes contractor registration, material standards and responsibility for construction safety. No registration fee/levy rate is printed on the page read.

gaps.what: Bonds, BG, Insurances, Stamp Duty, CIDB, bank charge, office rental, invoice finance interest, etc.
gaps.why: No printed bank-guarantee commission rate, insurance premium rate, CIDB levy amount, bank charge schedule or invoice-finance interest rate was found in the sources read. Only statutory stamp-duty rates are available.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the relevant bank/insurer/CIDB rate cards and the actual office rental quote; do not infer percentages from stamp-duty rates.

notes: WBS/BOQ line item from research/alaska-geg-wbs/alaska_breakdown.txt (5/6/7 Construction indirect, commissioning, EPC indirect).
